questions.q: In an agricultural field, which among the following is the highest producer of methane?
questions.solution:
Rice is grown in flooded fields, a situation that depletes the soil of oxygen. Soils that are anaerobic (lacking oxygen) allow the bacteria that produce methane from decomposing organic matter to thrive. Some of this methane then bubbles to the surface, but most of it is diffused back into the atmosphere through the rice plants themselves. Hence, rice Paddy field that produces maximum methane gas into the atmosphere.
Hence, option (b) is correct.

questions.q: The chemical entities present in thermosphere of the atmosphere are
questions.solution: The thermosphere is the fourth layer of the earth's atmosphere and is located above the mesosphere. The air is thin in the thermosphere. The earth's thermosphere also includes the region of the atmosphere, called the ionosphere. The ionosphere is the region of the atmosphere that is filled with charged particles such as $\mathrm{O}_2^{+}$, $\mathrmO^{+}, \mathrm{NO}^{+}$. The high temperature in the thermosphere can cause molecules to ionize.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Among the following compounds, which one is not responsible for depletion of ozone layer?
questions.solution:
In stratosphere the following reactions takes place which are responsible for depletion of ozone layer.
$\begin{aligned} & \mathrm{NO}+\mathrm{O}_3 \longrightarrow \mathrm{NO}_2+\mathrm{O}_2 \\ & \mathrm{CF}_2 \mathrm{Cl}_2 \stackrel{h v}{\longrightarrow} \dot{\mathrm{C}} \mathrm{F}_2 \mathrm{Cl}+\dot{\mathrm{Cl}} \\ & \mathrm{CFCl}_3 \stackrel{h v}{\longrightarrow} \dot{\mathrm{C}} \mathrm{FCl}_2+\dot{\mathrm{C}} \mathrm{l} \\ & \dot{\mathrm{C}} 1+\mathrm{O}_3 \longrightarrow \mathrm{Cl} \dot{\mathrm{O}}+\mathrm{O}_2 \\ & \mathrm{Cl} \dot{\mathrm{O}}+\mathrm{O} \longrightarrow \dot{\mathrm{C}}+\mathrm{O}_2 \\ & \end{aligned}$
Hence, methane $\left(\mathrm{CH}_4\right)$ is not responsible for ozone layer depletion.
questions.question: Among the following compounds, which one is not responsible for depletion of ozone layer?
questions.explanation:
In stratosphere the following reactions takes place which are responsible for depletion of ozone layer.
$\begin{aligned} & \mathrm{NO}+\mathrm{O}_3 \longrightarrow \mathrm{NO}_2+\mathrm{O}_2 \\ & \mathrm{CF}_2 \mathrm{Cl}_2 \stackrel{h v}{\longrightarrow} \dot{\mathrm{C}} \mathrm{F}_2 \mathrm{Cl}+\dot{\mathrm{Cl}} \\ & \mathrm{CFCl}_3 \stackrel{h v}{\longrightarrow} \dot{\mathrm{C}} \mathrm{FCl}_2+\dot{\mathrm{C}} \mathrm{l} \\ & \dot{\mathrm{C}} 1+\mathrm{O}_3 \longrightarrow \mathrm{Cl} \dot{\mathrm{O}}+\mathrm{O}_2 \\ & \mathrm{Cl} \dot{\mathrm{O}}+\mathrm{O} \longrightarrow \dot{\mathrm{C}}+\mathrm{O}_2 \\ & \end{aligned}$
Hence, methane $\left(\mathrm{CH}_4\right)$ is not responsible for ozone layer depletion.
